# Inflexion - AI-era marketing agency
> This file helps AI crawlers understand what content to prioritise.

## Services
- AEO / Answer Engine Optimisation: Prompt set audits, source authority mapping, content built for citation
- AI Discovery: Cross-model citation testing, share of answer tracking
- Retail Media: Algorithmic shelf optimisation, paid/organic separation
- AI Consultancy: Operating model design, 90-day build plans, team restructuring
- Technical GEO: Schema, llms.txt, crawler access, structured data
- Digital PR for AEO: Earn citations in sources AI models trust
